description: Generate instrument-ready voicings for a chord in a specified style. Pass previousNotes (or a previousVoicing object) from an earlier result to get a voiceLeadingScore for the transition. Styles: rootless, bill_evans, shell, triad, pad, guide-tones, guide-tone-1, guide-tone-2, both-guide-tones, drop-2, drop-3.

density.description: Target voicing density / note count hint

keyContext.description: Key context for diatonic color hooks (e.g. 'C major')

previousNotes.description: Previous voicing notes for voice leading (e.g. ['E3', 'G3', 'Bb3', 'D4'])

previousVoicing.description: Prior generate_voicing JSON result for strict guide-tone line tracking

style.description: Voicing style (default: 'pad'). bill_evans is an alias of rootless.

name: generate_voicing
